title: Literal MultiMCW is skipped for 64 <= L <= 4095 though §6.3.7 defines it for L > 63; warning text is off by one
body:
## Summary

The literal MultiMCW estimator is skipped for every input of `64 <= L <= 4095` samples, although SP 800-90B §6.3.7 defines it for `L > 63` (the smallest of its four windows is 63). When it is skipped the reported entropy is the minimum over fewer estimators, so it can only be `>=` the compliant figure. The warning text is also off by one.

## Location

`cpp/non_iid/multi_mcw_test.h:9,16-19`:

```c
int W[NUM_WINS] = {63, 255, 1023, 4095};      // NUM_WINS == 4
...
if(len < W[NUM_WINS-1]+1){                     // len < 4096
    printf("\t*** Warning: not enough samples to run multiMCW test (need more than %d) ***\n", W[NUM_WINS-1]+1);  // prints 4096
    return -1.0;                               // dropped from the minimum by the `if (ret >= 0)` guard in non_iid_main.cpp
}
```

## Reproduction

Built at `87c104d`.

```
python3 -c "import random;r=random.Random(9);open('m4095.bin','wb').write(bytes(r.randrange(256) for _ in range(4095)))"
python3 -c "import random;r=random.Random(9);open('m4096.bin','wb').write(bytes(r.randrange(256) for _ in range(4096)))"
./ea_non_iid -vv m4095.bin 8    # Literal MultiMCW ABSENT; prints "*** Warning: not enough samples to run multiMCW test (need more than 4096) ***"
./ea_non_iid -vv m4096.bin 8    # "Literal MultiMCW Prediction Estimate: ... min entropy = 7.0007111463554326"
```

At `L = 4095` the literal MultiMCW does not run; at `L = 4096` it does.

## Two problems

1. **Coverage.** §6.3.7 defines MultiMCW for `L > 63`; windows larger than the data can sit out (step 3a.ii, `frequent_j = Null`). The guard `len < 4096` excludes the entire range `64..4095`, so for those inputs the reported minimum omits an estimator that the standard includes. The reported figure can only be higher than the compliant one.
2. **Off-by-one message.** The check is `len < 4096`, so `len == 4096` is accepted, yet the message says "need more than 4096". It should read "need at least 4096" (or "more than 4095").

I confirmed the skip boundary and the message text; I did not reconstruct a specific input where the omitted estimator is the binding minimum (a drifting-MCV construction), so the magnitude of the resulting over-report is not quantified here.

## Suggested fix (not submitted as code)

Let MultiMCW run whenever `len > W[0]` (63), with each window `W[k] >= len` sitting out per step 3a.ii, and correct the warning text.

Found during an audit of this tool for a downstream use that prices output length on the reported min-entropy.
